The '''Makrin creeper''' was a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]]. The insect-like creatures appeared to be made up of earth and wood, but in reality, these were parts of their natural camouflage made of cords of muscle and nerve-rich tissue.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Makrin Creeper}}</ref> Born deep underground, makrin young left their proto-bark casings, digging their way to surface. <ref name="gsi">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Origins Of The Markin|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>[[File:MarkinProtoBark-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|Proto-bark shed from a young makrin as it dug its way to the surface<ref>{{TORcite|type=other|Proto-bark, a mission item from "Origins Of The Makrin"}}</ref>]]

During the [[Galactic War]], when the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] took control of the planet Makeb, the Makrin's home planet, some Makrin proved to be formidable opponents against the forces of those who wished to explore Makeb's natural beauty, although they were normally docile unless attacked.<ref name="cartel" /> Unscrupulous vendors were known to have sold common tree branches falsely labeled as "Creeper Trophies" to tourists. It was not unheard of for travelers to camp on small hillocks which, unknown to them, were large Makrin Creepers who had partially buried themselves to blend into their environment.<ref name="codex" /> Additionally, some makrin creepers were observed to spit a sticky substance at enemies.<ref name="cartel" />
